ops.entry: WHEN a FAIL run's fix lands main-session-direct, outside any run DO leave cycles_used as the lead digest evidences it and name the uncounted round in the return and the briefing — run-end refuses a count that disagrees with the digest's own evidence.
ops.why: The old entry directed a re-close with run-end --cycles-used 1; the ship review records that call refused, and feature-record.py carries the refusal ('cycles_used disagrees with authentic digest evidence').

ops.entry: WHEN pinning review_sha DO use feature-record.py pin-review, and sequence seam commit, pin, gh-sync status review, commit, re-pin, commit so the pin-precedes-station invariant never trips.
ops.why: The old entry said feature-record.py has no review_sha verb; its --help now lists pin-review. The sequencing half still holds.
Premise false in the tree: run digests and state files are tracked, and git check-ignore exits 1 on a runs digest path; only runs/*/ui is ignored.
Same false premise: run digests are tracked and survive the merge, so they do not die with the worktree.

ops.entry: WHEN a distill dispatch says to bring a merged feature's worktree current DO diff its tree against the remote default-branch tip, never rebase — the write guard refuses every HEAD move, an empty diff after a squash merge shows content already current, and moving history is the main session's.
ops.why: Prior distill run: git rebase was refused by bash-write-guard, while git diff HEAD origin/main was empty after the squash merge.

originals.original: WHEN a FAIL run's fix lands main-session-direct, outside any run DO attribute its cycle by re-closing that FAIL run with run-end --cycles-used 1 — check-state demands cycles_used cover every FAIL run, the re-close rewrites ended_at but keeps tokens, and the regate judgement lands on the next run-start.

WHEN pinning review_sha DO write it through feature_json_write.write_feature_json with a transform (lock plus schema check) — feature-record.py has no review_sha verb — and sequence seam commit, pin, gh-sync status review, commit, re-pin, commit so the pin-precedes-station invariant never trips.

WHEN a run directory or its digests appear absent from git status or from a gitignore-respecting search DO NOT read that as a false digest claim — the runs tree is gitignored here, so search it with gitignore off and settle ownership with git check-ignore.

WHEN dispatching feature-close distillation after a merge DO name the surviving artifacts explicitly — the runs tree is gitignored, so every run digest died with the worktree the post-merge hook removed, leaving only `notes/` and `observations/`. Unnamed, a lead hunts for files that no longer exist.
